scores.evidence: Each of the 3 objectives still has 3 or more graded items with objectiveId (o1: q0, q1, e1, e2; o2: q2, q3, e3, e4; o3: q4, q5, e5, e6). o1 is 'create / 設計できる' but is only assessed by selection, and e1 and e2 still carry bloom 'create'. No practice step asks the learner to design a check.
hook-lead sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences ('「完了しました。正しく動作します」…翌日、別の入力でエラーが出ました。何があれば防げたでしょうか。'), followed by the predict item q0 (o1) with tempting distractors.

s1-table is now a list and keeps the English glosses on first use ('**ビルド（build）**', '**スクリーンショット（screenshot）の比較**'). s1-defs still defines 検証, 自動テスト and リンター before the list uses them. The recall of 第1回's agentic loop in s1-why is unchanged.

measure.mjs: 'prose 2242 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 3218 · practice reading 1046 · questions 12 · est 19.5 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)'. The longer s4-fresh sentence added 14 characters of prose (previously 2228). The est formula gives (3218+1046)/450 + 8 + 2 = 19.48, which still rounds to estMinutes 19. The '19.5' is only toFixed(1) display rounding. The new s4-fresh sentence ('このサブエージェントは、差分と渡された基準をもとに、自分でコードを読んで確かめます。') is about 41 characters and brings in no new term. lint --strict shows 0 warnings. 4-4 is still the heaviest section, with 10 blocks.

s3-code uses a named import ('import { equal } from \'node:assert/strict\';') with the 4 cases that s3-steps expects ('fail 4', then 'pass 4・fail 0'). The practice still repeats the flow fully prompted rather than fading to independent work.

Every content section still ends with an applied inline quiz, with feedback on every wrong option. In this round only e5's explanation changed. Its options, key and feedback are the same, so retrieval demand is unchanged.

e5's explanation now reads '別のコンテキストのレビュー役は、作業の経緯を見ずに、差分と渡された基準をもとに判断します。' That still answers option a's misconception (self-grading in the same conversation; its feedback says '作業の経緯を見ていない、別のコンテキストに頼みます') and option d's misconception (no criteria). It no longer suggests the reviewer is limited to the diff text. The other distractor feedback still names concrete errors, for example e4 c ('無視する設定を残すと、検証の手段が1つ減ります').
s4-sort keeps its 5 nodes, its caption ('必須にするのは、正しさと要件に関わる指摘だけ') and a full alt. s1-table and p-model-sort are lists that bold the key term. There are no decorative images.

The file names are consistent across p-prompt-write, p-prompt-green and p-model-code (leap.test.mjs / leap.mjs). p-checklist p-c1 to p-c7 gives clear success criteria. The hint ladder is shallow, because p-evidence and p-commit have no hints, and no step transfers o1.
summary-points comes after the exam. summary-next keeps its reflection question ('手元のタスクに、どの確認を渡せますか。'). There are 7 retrieval flashcards.

Both changes remove an overstatement. The old s4-fresh said 'サブエージェントが見るのは、差分と渡された基準だけです'. The new one says the subagent '差分と渡された基準をもとに、自分でコードを読んで確かめます'. This matches facts-cc-04-verify.md [practice-20] ('a subagent reviews the diff in a fresh context against the plan') and facts-cc-07-skills-subagents.md ('It runs in its own context window with its own system prompt, tools and permissions'). It also matches the lesson's own s4-prompt expect ('レビュー役のサブエージェントが差分を読み…') and the s4-defs definition ('自分のコンテキストで別に動き…'). e5's explanation now says the same thing ('作業の経緯を見ずに、差分と渡された基準をもとに判断します'), so the two blocks no longer contradict each other or cc-07. Both blocks keep cite cc-best-practices.
The changed sentences use です・ます ('…自分でコードを読んで確かめます。', '…をもとに判断します。'). Lint finds no banned phrases. s2-goal still repeats 判定 within one sentence; that wording belongs to the ja-editor.
The lesson is jp only and complete. s4-sort's alt describes the full flow. Lists replace the 2 tables (mobile fit). The links have descriptive text ('[日本語の公式ドキュメント](…/best-practices)').

summary: Verification round (review-scope exit 0: 2 of 58 blocks changed (s4-fresh, check-quiz e5), 2% of parts; sections and objectives unchanged). The previous review had no open must-fix items, so nothing needed resolving. I reviewed both changed blocks in full. s4-fresh and e5's explanation no longer say the reviewer sees only the diff and the criteria. They now say it does not see the work history and reads the code itself, which matches facts-cc-04-verify.md [practice-20], the cc-07 subagent facts and the lesson's own s4-prompt expect. Neither change introduces an error or regression. validate: 0 errors. lint --strict: 0 warnings. measure.mjs: prose 2242 (budget 1,200–2,400) and est 19.48, displayed as 19.5, which still rounds to estMinutes 19. I re-scored load, active, miscon, accuracy and voice, all unchanged, and carried the other scores over. align and practice stay at 3, because o1 (create) is still assessed only by selection (niceToHave).
